title: REQ · Runner writes a report after every run whatever the outcome
summary: Runner calls a Reporter on success, failure and approval wait
description: Context: Runner.Run returns from several branches (agent failure, publish failure, awaiting approval, completed). Desired behavior: an optional Reporter set via SetReporter is called once after any run that acquired the lock, with the final execution and timestamps. Runs refused by lock.ErrLocked write nothing. Expected result: every executed run leaves a report. Why: reports must exist whatever the outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failing agent, When Run returns, Then a report with status FAILED and the error text is written
Given a successful run with and without AutoPublish, When Run returns, Then reports with COMPLETED and AWAITING_APPROVAL are written
Given the lock is held, When Run is called, Then no report is written

preserve: Run return values and persisted store records

technical_constraints: Reporter is an interface so tests fake it
